_comment: Edit Traditional Chinese (zhHant) and English (en) here. Use {count}, {n}, {total}, {earned}, {paws}, {seconds}, {answer} where shown.

welcomeLede.zhHant: 和狗狗 Pip、貓咪 Miso 一起檢查回收食物——真正餵寵物前，一定要先問大人。
welcomeLede.en: Help Pip the dog and Miso the cat inspect rescued food — then always ask a grown-up before feeding a real pet.

contentDraftBanner.zhHant: 卡片已通過內部 QA，但尚未完成專業審核——這不是獸醫建議，餵寵物前請先問大人。
contentDraftBanner.en: Cards are QA-checked but not yet professionally reviewed — this is not veterinary advice. Always ask a grown-up before feeding a pet.

instruction1.zhHant: 看看食物照片、名稱和製作說明。
instruction1.en: Look at the food photo, name and preparation details.

instruction2.en: Tap optional clues if you want a hint.

instruction3.zhHant: 選擇可能適合邊個：狗點心、貓點心、狗同貓都得，或狗同貓都唔得。
instruction3.en: Choose who it might suit: Dog snack, Cat snack, Both, or Neither.

instruction4.zhHant: 完成 {count} 種食物各得一隻爪印。第一次答錯還可以再試一次。
instruction4.en: Earn one paw for each of {count} foods you finish. You can try again if your first guess needs another look.

attemptNote.zhHant: 再仔細看看——你還有一次機會。
attemptNote.en: Take another careful look — you have one more try.

answerGroupAria.en: Who could this food be for?

feedbackRetryBody.zhHant: 呢個選擇，同張相唔太夾。睇下點樣整同啲貼士，再試一次。
feedbackRetryBody.en: That choice does not match this food’s details. Check the preparation and clues, then try once more.

completionLede.zhHant: 你檢查了 {total} 種食物，收集了 {paws} 隻爪印。Pip 同 Miso 為你proud！
completionLede.en: You inspected {total} foods and collected {paws} progress paws. Pip and Miso are proud of you!

inactivityDesc.zhHant: 仲有 {seconds} 秒，我哋就讓個位畀你。下一位小朋友都想玩！
inactivityDesc.en: In {seconds} seconds we’ll hand the seat to the next kid.

assetPreviewLede.zhHant: 缺少的檔案會顯示標籤佔位圖，不會出現破圖圖示。請把檔案放到 public/assets/ 並使用相同路徑。
assetPreviewLede.en: Missing files show labelled placeholders instead of broken-image icons. Replace files under public/assets/ using the same paths.

safety5.zhHant: 小食只可以佔寵物每日熱量的百分之十以下——小食是小食，不是正餐。
safety5.en: Treats should be under 10% of a pet's daily calories — treats are treats, not meals.

dogSnackLegend.zhHant: 「狗點心」代表這食物適合做狗的小食，不代表貓吃了會中毒。
dogSnackLegend.en: “Dog snack” means the food suits a dog as a treat. It does not mean it is poison for a cat.

adultPanelBody.zhHant: 呢個遊戲，只教一個習慣：餵之前，先問大人。遊戲入面嘅食物，係廚房或街市未用過、仲安全嘅剩餘食物，同食剩嘅餸、壞咗嘅食物唔同。答案由我哋根據 ASPCA 同 FDA 嘅公開指引整理，唔係獸醫建議，亦都唔會教你餵幾多。同小朋友坐低一齊讀，就係最好嘅玩法。
adultPanelBody.en: This game teaches one habit: ask a grown-up before feeding a pet. The foods in it are unused, still-safe surplus from kitchens and markets — not plate scraps, and not spoiled food. Our answers are put together from public guidance by the ASPCA and the FDA. It is not veterinary advice, and it will not tell you how much to feed. Sit down and read it together — that is the whole game.

pipRetry.zhHant: 唔緊要，我第一次都揀錯。
pipRetry.en: It's okay. I get these wrong too.

pipCorrect.en: Yes! I'll stamp this paw for you.

misoHandoff.zhHant: 去搵大人。我陪你行過去。
misoHandoff.en: Go find a grown-up. I'll walk with you.

misoDone.en: Don't tell him I said that.
